You'll investigate data discrepancies, resolve issues with meter readings and liaise with internal teams, suppliers and third parties to ensure information is accurate and up to date.

- Manage meter and AMR installations, exchanges, removals and associated data flows

title: Personal Assistant
company: Northern Care Alliance NHS Foundation Trust

description: An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Personal Assistant to support the Ward Managers on The Acute Respiratory Unit at Fairfield General Hospital, providing administrative support and office management. ARCU is a fast paced respiratory and general medical ward also caring for patients under ENT. Working in an NHS ward environment requires resilience and emotional intelligence, as you will support staff working in a high-pressure clinical setting. We are looking for a candidate who is organised, professional and discreet, calm under pressure, is flexible and adaptable, proactive and solution focused, and team orientated. A candidate with excellent time management, is highly motivated, caring and able to always maintain confidentiality. Act as first point of contact for all communication for the Ward Manager. Communicate professionally and effectively with Senior Management, clinicians, and colleagues internally and externally. Provide a confidential secretarial service, maintaining confidentiality at all times. Assist the Ward Manager in roster management. Maintaining an accurate reflection of sickness and absence and annual leave key performance indicators. Provide, receive, and manage information electronically, verbally or in writing which may be of a confidential or sensitive nature, which may involve individual staff or patient matters or matters of commercial confidence. Provide diary management, arranging of meetings, appointments and interviews as required. To prepare and type meeting agendas and take, type, and distribute minutes of meetings/personnel records. To maintain internal filing systems aligned in accordance with the non-clinical records management strategy. Work in a self- directed manner to progress aspects of the Ward Managers actions that do not require their direct involvement. Take responsibility for planning and prioritising own workload, ensuring that requirements are met. To read more information about the advertised role, and the main job duties/responsibilities please open the Job Description and Person Specification located under the supporting documents heading. You can also read more information about working at the Northern Care Alliance within the attached Candidate Information Pack or by visiting our careers website: www.careers.northerncarealliance.nhs.uk We reserve the right to close the online vacancy when we are in receipt of sufficient applications. Should you wish to apply for this post you are advised to complete and return your application form as soon as possible.
